text: Recent forecasts miss because the target process underwent a level shift/drift in the recent/test period that the black-box turbine-ar model trained on earlier history does not track.
rationale: Objective states forecasts miss a recent level change; sample shows targets ~200; a persistent mean shift in recent data would cause a fixed AR model trained on older level to systematically under/over-predict.

text: Apparent recent miss is an artifact of invalid split hygiene (train/test date overlap or non-chronological assignment) rather than true process change.
rationale: Evaluation uses train/test split column; if splits overlap in time or were randomly assigned, horizon evaluation is invalid and apparent recent miss could be artifact of improper validation rather than true drift.

text: Recent miss reflects persistent model misspecification (autocorrelated/biased residuals) present in all periods, not a new recent level shift in the target process.
rationale: Forecast diagnostics already show residual lag-1 autocorr 0.776, suggesting systematic structure left in residuals beyond a simple level shift. Plausible the AR model is misspecified throughout.
